text:
Maria: Quick follow-up from last night's postmortem (INC-2026-045) — we need to lock owners and timelines for the alert-tuning work (noise sweep, thresholds, dedupe rules, paging policy). I'm collecting action items here.
OncallBot: Incident INC-2026-045 marked RESOLVED by autoremediation at 2026-03-23T02:41:12Z — summary posted to /incidents/INC-2026-045.
Ashok: I can own dedupe/suppression rules and run a noise sweep across the last 30 days. ETA: EOD Thu.
Tam: I will take threshold tuning and historical evals. Need to run queries against prod for the 95/99p distributions — will do tomorrow morning.
Jules: I'll handle paging policy changes and rota updates. Proposal: move non-critical alerts into nightly low-priority route 00:00-06:00 and enable a 10m suppression window for flapping signals.
Maria: Good. Please add the PR links + the runbook snippets so support can follow during the rollout. Use label `pm-followup/INC-2026-045`.
Ashok: Putting a first-pass dedupe rule up: ```plaintext
# suppress repeated timeout errors if >20/min from same hostname
if count(error: "read timeout", host) > 20/min then suppress for 30m
```
Ashok: I'll run a dry-run against historical alerts to check false-suppression risk.
Tam: For thresholds, my plan:
- capture 30d p95/p99 for `model-serving.latency` and `request.err_rate`
- propose new alerts where p95 > 500ms and err_rate spike > 2x baseline
Will post the query results by 09:30 PT.
Jules: For paging: small nit — we should exclude internal CI namespaces from paging rules. I'll make a config diff and schedule a canary deploy.
Maria: Owner matrix so far: dedupe = Ashok, thresholds = Tam, paging/rota = Jules, follow-up doc + PM = Maria. Target completion: 2026-03-28.
Tam: One question — do we want an automated detection for recurring noisy alerts (monthly pattern)? I can prototype a simple recurrence detector that flags alerts with pattern score > 0.6.
Jules: Yes please — that would help prioritize long-term fixes vs temporary thresholds. I can add a monthly job to surface candidates to the ops dashboard.
Ashok: If the recurrence detector exists, we can auto-schedule a re-eval job that runs prior to any suppression PR merge.
Maria: Agree. Action sequencing:
1) Ashok: publish dedupe rules dry-run (EOD Thu)
2) Tam: post threshold analysis + proposed changes (tomorrow 09:30 PT)
3) Jules: prepare paging config + canary (Tues)
4) Maria: consolidate PRs and open follow-up tracking doc (by Fri)
Please react with :thumbsup: when you have created the PR or doc so I can tick items off.
Tam: 👍 I'll post the threshold queries this morning.
Ashok: 👍 created a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/observability/pull/482 (draft).
Jules: Draft paging config in branch `pager-night-policy` and a short runbook snippet in the branch too. Will open PR by EOD Tue.
Maria: Thanks all. If anyone hits blockers (data access, runbook gaps), call it out here — we'll reassign.
Tam: One more note — when tuning thresholds, let's also add a short post-change monitoring window (24h) with rollback automation if noise increases >15%.
Jules: Added a checklist item to my PR for rollback automation testing.
Maria: Perfect. Closing the loop here — I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a 15m sync next Wed to confirm rollouts.
OncallBot: Reminder scheduled: follow-up-sync (INC-2026-045) on 2026-03-25T16:00:00Z.
